13.original_instruction: Talk with the Guild Receptionist, "Demon Hunter", on the left, who tells you that the second test consists of gathering items to make arrows. Gather the items he requests, then talk with him again. Demon Hunter will request one of the following sets of items, chosen randomly:
13.short_ru: У Demon Hunter соберите и сдайте только выданный случайный набор материалов.
13.short_en: Collect and return only the random material set assigned by Demon Hunter.
13.full_ru: Поговорите с Guild Receptionist по имени Demon Hunter слева. Второе испытание — сбор материалов для стрел. Соберите запрошенные предметы и снова поговорите с ним. Demon Hunter случайно выбирает один из перечисленных ниже наборов. Наборы материалов: 1 — 5 Claw of Desert Wolf, 5 Trunk, 3 White Herb; 2 — 9 Worm Peeling, 9 Shell, 9 Yellow Herb; 3 — 3 Dokebi Horn, 3 Piece of Egg Shell, 10 Fluff; 4 — 3 Venom Canine, 5 Red Herb, 3 Animal Skin; 5 — 3 Bill of Birds, 5 Skel-bone, 3 Green Herb; 6 — 3 Tooth of Bat, 1 Sticky Mucus, 1 Bear's Footskin; 7 — 2 Porcupine Quill, 1 Yoyo Tail, 1 Acorn.

14.original_instruction: Talk with Sherin again, who instructs you to meet another guild member in Payon to take the final test. Tip : Bring enough healing items to recover all of your HP at least once for the final test.
14.short_ru: Получите у Sherin направление в Payon; возьмите лечение хотя бы на полное восстановление HP.
14.short_en: Get Sherin's referral to Payon; bring healing for at least one full HP recovery.
14.full_ru: Снова поговорите с Sherin: она направит вас к другому NPC (guild member) в Payon на финальное испытание. Совет: возьмите достаточно лечения, чтобы хотя бы раз полностью восстановить HP во время финального испытания.
14.full_en: Talk with Sherin again, who instructs you to meet another guild member in Payon to take the final test. Tip : Bring enough healing items to recover all of your HP at least once for the final test.

requirements.condition: Recommendation for the final test, not a fixed item cost or a requirement to consume a particular potion.

15.original_instruction: Go to the building in Payon situated to the east of the central castle (payon (185, 233)). Enter the first room on your right, then talk with the guild member and ask to take the final test. The guild member will give you 200 Silver Arrows and transfer you to a waiting room. Walk forward and the examiner will explain the test to you. The test area is a maze populated with Porings , Zombies , Archer Skeletons , and Mummies , and scattered with puddles of water. You are required to complete three objectives in order and within 3 minutes to pass the test:
15.short_ru: В здании Payon (payon 185, 233) получите 200 Silver Arrows и инструкции к трём целям за 3 минуты.
15.short_en: In the Payon building (payon 185, 233), receive 200 Silver Arrows and instructions for three ordered objectives within 3 minutes.
15.full_ru: Идите к зданию в Payon к востоку от центрального замка (payon (185, 233)). Войдите в первую комнату справа, поговорите с guild member и попросите финальное испытание. Он выдаст 200 Silver Arrows и перенесёт вас в комнату ожидания. Пройдите вперёд: examiner объяснит правила. В лабиринте находятся Porings, Zombies, Archer Skeletons и Mummies, а также лужи. Для успеха нужно выполнить три цели по порядку за 3 минуты. Когда будете готовы начать испытание, войдите в чат receptionist и дождитесь переноса в зону испытания.
15.full_en: Go to the building in Payon situated to the east of the central castle (payon (185, 233)). Enter the first room on your right, then talk with the guild member and ask to take the final test. The guild member will give you 200 Silver Arrows and transfer you to a waiting room. Walk forward and the examiner will explain the test to you. The test area is a maze populated with Porings , Zombies , Archer Skeletons , and Mummies , and scattered with puddles of water. You are required to complete three objectives in order and within 3 minutes to pass the test: When you are ready to begin the test, enter the receptionist's chat room and wait until you are transferred to the test area.

npcs.evidence: Exit the maze. All of the monsters will die once the required number of target monsters have been killed. The six target monsters are comprised of: | 1 Poring, located in the north. | 3 Zombies, each located in the east, west, and center respectively. | 1 Archer Skeleton, located in the east. | 1 Mummy, located in the south-west. The switch is located at the center of the maze, and can be activated by clicking it. The exit is located in the north. Tip : You can activate the switch from a distance; you don't need to stand next to it. You will fail the test if any of the following happens: | You kill any monster that is not labelled "Job Change Monster". | You walk in any of the puddles of water. | You fail to complete the objectives within the allocated time. | You are killed. When you are ready to begin the test, enter the receptionist's chat room and wait until you are transferred to the test area.

requirements.condition: One shared limit for the ordered kill/switch/exit objectives, not a fresh timer per source step.

18.full_ru: Выйдите из лабиринта. Когда нужное число целей будет убито, все монстры погибнут. Всего шесть целей: 1 Poring на севере; 3 Zombies на востоке, западе и в центре соответственно; 1 Archer Skeleton на востоке; 1 Mummy на юго-западе. switch расположен в центре лабиринта и активируется щелчком; выход — на севере. switch можно активировать издалека, подходить вплотную не нужно. Испытание провалится, если убить монстра без метки «Job Change Monster», наступить в лужу, не уложиться в отведённое время или погибнуть. Когда будете готовы начать, войдите в чат receptionist и дождитесь переноса в зону испытания.
18.full_en: Exit the maze. All of the monsters will die once the required number of target monsters have been killed. The six target monsters are comprised of: | 1 Poring, located in the north. | 3 Zombies, each located in the east, west, and center respectively. | 1 Archer Skeleton, located in the east. | 1 Mummy, located in the south-west. The switch is located at the center of the maze, and can be activated by clicking it. The exit is located in the north. Tip : You can activate the switch from a distance; you don't need to stand next to it. You will fail the test if any of the following happens: | You kill any monster that is not labelled "Job Change Monster". | You walk in any of the puddles of water. | You fail to complete the objectives within the allocated time. | You are killed. When you are ready to begin the test, enter the receptionist's chat room and wait until you are transferred to the test area.

reviews.detail: The source supplies ten exact answers in order without question stems. Keep them as dialogue choices, not world movement/healing/trading objectives. No invented question wording or input mode.

Pinned HTML restores seven random three-item sets omitted by the extractor. One assigned branch governs all three items; never require all sets or independently mix items. Branch narrative is authored from that table and the unchanged assignment instruction, with each typed material citing the literal HTML row.

Kill any four labelled targets. Six target population entries 1+3+1+1 are not six required kills. Regular species database links describe the maze, not verified IDs for special exam clones; target identities remain scoped with NULL IDs. Shared three-minute timer governs all ordered objectives.

The waiting-room chat instruction printed at the end of stage 18 is preparation before an attempt. It is an explicitly conditioned action, not a requirement to restart after a successful exit. Water, unlabelled kills, death and timeout are independent failure conditions.

Demon Hunter and the unnamed waiting-room receptionist are not merged by occupation. Guild member and examiner remain distinct; building entrance is not an invented interior NPC point. Falcon rental is an optional post-job tip with unknown fee/duration, not another job-change cost.
